items.title: Detroit calls: Global Summit and new board directors
items.summary: PMI’s Global Summit runs October 21 to 24 in Detroit. On October 22 the Annual Membership Meeting will announce the directors members elected for the 2027 to 2029 term, and members can watch it online.
items.take: Block your calendar now. Nothing beats a deadline you set before the sponsor does.

items.title: PMI hands off its own project: a new interim CEO
items.summary: Pierre Le Manh stepped down as PMI President and CEO on September 30. Chief Growth Officer Johannes Heinlein is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
items.take: Even the profession’s home base ran a handoff plan. When did you last test yours?

items.title: Centaur or cyborg? How to work with AI on your plan
items.summary: A study of 758 consultants found AI sped up and improved work on tasks inside its strengths, but led to fewer correct answers on a task outside them. Successful users either split work with AI (centaurs) or wove it through every step (cyborgs). This is 2023 research that still shapes PM tool advice today.
items.take: Before you accept an AI-drafted plan, ask which part of it you actually checked.
